title: Athletic editor Steven Ginsberg addresses Dianna Russini situation in all-hands meeting

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Athletic editor Steven Ginsberg addresses Dianna Russini situation in all-hands meeting
sources.description: When the photos of Patriots coach Mike Vrabel and reporter Dianna Russini first emerged 22 days ago, they were accompanied by three strong denials of impropriety — one from Vrabel, one from Russini, and one from Russini's employer, The Athletic.
